svg.title: Projects
svg.desc: Life Ledger: Tasks, goals, meals and money in one app, with an assistant that turns what you say into entries. YTFast: YouTube Music, native and fast. A desktop app for Windows and Mac, for YouTube Music Premium accounts. draftcue: Rewrite selected text in place with Gemini using a keyboard shortcut. Youtube-ify: A YouTube-inspired control layer with reliable shortcuts, cinema mode, and true fullscreen for HTML5 video across the web. hermes-monitoring: Resort operations app: tasks, shifts, maintenance and supervisor checks for every staff role (Next.js, Supabase). prompt-enhancer-extension: Chrome extension that improves your AI prompts in place, using the context of the conversation.
